title: Cadet Watch
summary: Start: enter Cadet Watch. The log opens the job and the helm marks Helion Compact Cutter 1. Do: come within 320 meters of that cutter. The training patrol hails paint rounds before live guns. The ice ring is a counted cut and the salvage is bad on purpose. Finish: after the cutter is met, come inside Cadet Yard's shell. The Compact writes standing. A shot in the green still goes on the slate. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close. The shell alone does not file it.
